title: Pure Prank-Kids
summary: Pure Prank-Kids with generic staples. Whenever any of the four Main Deck kids is sent to the GY as Fusion or Link Material for a Prank-Kids monster, it fires its own bonus effect and Special Summons another differently named kid from the hand or Deck.

summary.title: Starters & The Four Kids
points: Prank-Kids Place searches any Prank-Kids monster on activation, boosts your monsters by 500 ATK when you Fusion Summon a Prank-Kids, and drops opposing monsters by 500 ATK when you Link Summon one.

Prank-Kids Lampsies (FIRE Pyro) burns the opponent for 500 damage, Prank-Kids Dropsies (WATER Aqua) gains 1000 LP, Prank-Kids Fansies (WIND Thunder) sends a Prank-Kids card from the Deck to the GY, and Prank-Kids Rocksies (EARTH Rock) banishes a card from your hand to draw 1 card before each summons the next kid from the hand or Deck.
Because Link-1 Prank-Kids Meow-Meow-Mu is Forbidden, openings begin with Prank-Kids Pandemonium fusing two kids from the hand, or two kids on the field linking into Prank-Kids Dodo-Doodle-Doo.

summary.title: Opening: Any 2 Kids + Pandemonium
steps: Activate Prank-Kids Pandemonium (or search it after linking two fielded kids into Prank-Kids Dodo-Doodle-Doo) to Fusion Summon Prank-Kids Rocket Ride using two differently named kids.
Chain both kids in the GY to burn, gain LP, mill or draw and Special Summon two more differently named kids from the Deck in Defense Position.
Link Summon Prank-Kids Dodo-Doodle-Doo with the two summoned kids to search Prank-Kids Pandemonium or Prank-Kids Pranks, while the third and fourth kids trigger in the GY to refill the board.
Tribute Dodo-Doodle-Doo or Rocket Ride to add back or revive two Prank-Kids cards with different names, setting Prank-Kids Pandemonium or Prank-Kids Plan for the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Prank-Kids Battle Butler (Fusion of Lampsies, Dropsies and Fansies) tributes itself as a Quick Effect to destroy all monsters the opponent controls, and floats into a non-Fusion monster from the GY if destroyed by the opponent.
Prank-Kids Rip-Roarin-Roaster (Link-4) tributes itself as a Quick Effect to destroy all Spells and Traps the opponent controls.

Prank-Kids Bow-Wow-Bark (Link-2) tributes itself on the opponent's turn to add two differently named Prank-Kids cards from your GY to your hand and protects your Prank-Kids from card effect destruction for the turn.
Prank-Kids Weather Washer (Fusion) tributes itself on the opponent's turn to revive two non-Fusion Prank-Kids from the GY with battle protection.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Prank-Kids Pandemonium Fusion Summons a Prank-Kids Fusion during either Main Phase from the hand or field, locking you into Prank-Kids summons for the rest of that turn.

Prank-Kids Plan Link Summons a Prank-Kids Link during either Main Phase and banishes itself from the GY when the opponent declares an attack to shuffle back GY Prank-Kids and shrink the attacker by 100 per card returned.
Prank-Kids Pranks discards a Prank-Kids card to summon a Prank-Kids Token for Link climbing, and shuffles three Prank-Kids cards from the GY into the Deck each End Phase to draw 1 card.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Prank-Kids Meow-Meow-Mu is Forbidden in the TCG, so the deck opens with two-card Fusion or Link plays instead of 1-card Link-1 lines.
